text: 🍿 'Clayface' turns Gotham's mud man into body horror, and early reactions like it 📆 Release: October 23, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Horror · #Superhero ✈️ Add to watchlist James Watkins (the man behind 'Eden Lake' and 'Speak No Evil') directs an R-rated Batman spin-off, and /Film has the first screening reactions in. That's a filmmaker who knows how to make cruelty uncomfortable, which suits a villain whose body is the horror. The script comes from Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, so expect a tragic monster story, not a capes-and-quips one. Tom Rhys Harries as Matt Hagen has to sell both the charm and the melting. Social reactions are always generous, so the real test is the full reviews. The cast also includes Naomi Ackie and David Dencik.

🍿 Gerwig's Narnia starts with a lion singing the world into being 📆 Release: February 12, 2027 (theaters), April 2 on Netflix 🎭 Genre: #Fantasy · #Adventure ✈️ Add to watchlist We have the first trailer for 'The Magician's Nephew', with two newcomers as Digory and Polly, Daniel Craig and Meryl Streep in support, and Led Zeppelin's "Stairway to Heaven" over the first steps into another world. Picking the creation story is a smart way into Narnia. It skips the wardrobe and the Pevensies, and it lets Greta Gerwig play with myth and wonder, as she did with the plastic utopia of 'Barbie' . A classic-rock needle drop says she isn't making a museum piece.

🎬 RJ Mitte, Flynn on 'Breaking Bad', has died at 34 His reps confirmed the death of RJ Mitte , who played Walter White Jr. across 56 episodes of 'Breaking Bad'. TMZ reports that a county official in Texas confirmed it, and the investigation is ongoing. If you or someone you know is struggling, call or text 988. Mitte has cerebral palsy, and he played Flynn without hiding it. That gave a disabled actor a lasting place on one of TV's great dramas. He also worked as an ambassador for United Cerebral Palsy and Shriners Children's. Flynn was the family's moral compass, and the show needed him to be that. ✈️ Add to watchlist
